title: From critical crossings to quenched near-critical universality in Voronoi percolation
summary: Taking Cardy's crossing formula for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation as an input, we prove a universal joint limit for the near-critical crossing thresholds of rational polygonal quadrilaterals under the monotone coupling. Conditional on the Poisson tessellation, the threshold law converges in probability over tessellations to the same law as on the triangular lattice. Each model is normalized by its own expected number of color-pivotal sites for a unit-square crossing.
family_title: Critical and quenched near-critical universality for Poisson–Voronoi percolation

review.reason: Derives near-critical crossing threshold limits for Voronoi percolation from Cardy's formula.
